evidence.locator: Lines 7-105, generated files and per-client activation

evidence.finding: Documents host-coordinator fan-out and result collection. Examples and stated defaults are documentary claims, not measured concurrency.

evidence.finding: Documents reviewer roles and host-agent review guidance. Prompt instructions do not establish a universal OS or merge authority gate.

evidence.title: squad: docs/src/content/docs/scenarios/multi-machine-watch.md
evidence.locator: Lines 7-75, opt-in work claims and host placement
evidence.finding: Watchers can run on user machines/pods. Git-ref claims are optional and off by default; unconfigured watchers can duplicate work.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/shell/index.ts
evidence.finding: CLI creates a coordinator session and named member sessions, passes approve-once permissions and dispatches multi routes with Promise.allSettled in the shared team root.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/shell/coordinator.ts
evidence.finding: Product prompt and response parser supply routing decisions rather than merely displaying provider subagents.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/shell/spawn.ts
evidence.finding: A supplied client creates a real SDK session in teamRoot; without a client the helper returns a stub. The stub is not execution evidence.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/commands/watch/config.ts
evidence.locator: DEFAULTS lines 203-211 and execute flags lines 281-290
evidence.finding: Execute is off by default, maxConcurrent is one and timeout is 30 minutes. Execute presets may bypass host permission prompts.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-cli/src/cli/core/backend-mcp.ts
evidence.finding: Experimental local backend needs explicit enablement and a registered execution harness. A backend URL alone is not a shipped remote server.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-sdk/src/runtime/telemetry.ts
evidence.locator: TelemetryCollector defaults, setConsent, flush and default transport
evidence.finding: SDK collector defaults disabled with an empty endpoint and no-op transport. setConsent and pluggable transports are SDK APIs, not proof of an app-wide privacy switch.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-sdk/src/runtime/otel-init.ts
evidence.finding: CLI can initialize OTel and bridge events. Endpoint configuration is separate from the collector consent flag.

evidence.title: squad: packages/squad-sdk/src/runtime/otel.ts
